name: Find paths with walk, drop and jump links
body: A* over the grid. Walk links join neighbours whose heights differ by at most the step height and whose capsule sweep is clear (this is what makes stairs work). Drop links go down at most the drop limit and need clear air. Jump links cross a gap no wider than a standing jump and no higher than her jump height; they are marked so the game knows when to press jump. Climb is never a link: she can't climb, so a route that needs it simply has no path. Straighten the path with line-of-sight checks without cutting corners.
